Name: Room Fix for Make Gunther Real
Author: rainbowlack
Description:
Changes the spouse room from Make Gunther Real to a more standard 6x9 tile size and resizes the bookshelf on the right. Fixes graphical error when used with PolyamorySweet Rooms.

Must be installed manually.


[size=5]Installation[/size][size=6]
[/size]Extract "spouseRoomGunther.tmx" to .../steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] Make Gunther Real/assets, and allow it to replace the pre-existing file.
